# New Path to Credit: 86% of On-Time Sezzle Up Users Without a Credit Score Had One Within Four Months


November 16, 2026


## New Path to Credit: 86% of On-Time Sezzle Up Users Without a Credit Score Had One Within Four Months


## Through the free, opt-in Sezzle Up program, users who started below a 600 credit score who paid on time gained an average of 17.6 points in four months


Minneapolis, MN, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- **Sezzle Inc. (NASDAQ:**[SEZL](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=v8SrxOPeMoxzBK2SQ_HESJPzJN_RbxJ3Qu6_9Rc7SnvL_eDCVRbbKH0gKWBQ_6LyEe1PEd5Yil6lqc2Yfh4DzRq67iBNdpfknO3xJsQPF_hkjDGBumtCewlbRPIaPS7t) ) ( **Sezzle** or **Company** ) // -[Sezzle](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=B6ZjNx8gfkorMPPxpja0pDkwXnNN1ZNdoj5tnWJw6u4U_DW5krqWvWKsoQGkfzeYlcVgt_RedOclJStjdOoYhQ==) , the digital financial platform helping the next generation shop, earn and build credit, today shared new results showing that **Sezzle Up, its free, opt-in credit reporting program,** is giving shoppers a new path to credit through the app they already use every day.


Young Americans are managing money differently than the generations before them. According to the[Federal Reserve’s 2025 Survey](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gPUuOVNJvaAuN8ntZmGneh-ogU8O7lfW4FPH-r4xsBwoPIyLomdin7qRz6Y49Wdv_XLsg2MHpVzIDkeSGRJu5uqGsCbPlPuBTzDu4y1QErU-pDlL42U5qm-yK1FlGln0eZssuOJFbunEJ-NAsmgmVJahEzaHQ4FtVvNx004k9NMfhzqPpa_6U-hJoXIf2TWrA2_WjW3sEzr8jXeFGYoemipA4Oz8R5Ybu0gaAdlMj6w=) of Household Economics and Decisionmaking, published in May 2026, **35% of adults under 30 don’t have a credit card** , compared with 8% of adults 60 and older. They’re also the age group most likely to use Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), with 22% using it in the past year. For many of them, the traditional path to credit, opening a card and building history from there, doesn’t fit how they pay.


**Sezzle is building for that shift.** The Sezzle app has become an everyday financial tool where shoppers pay over time with flexible payments, earn rewards and cash back, and learn money skills through[Money IQ](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3B57Uc9AFH8wz_axEEBGropmAtTtSlsUJjN2P1gEZa3oJHdoBhNMKRcIe4KfIJNnUpZG3FzSQ18_hRmruI6ELImkXlFDVUZPTFtuYawadS00fN1VwDD-qE0sfAka-7caKEa_FDpmKih8GG1PHY8qc5bENGFtKPjtMUwnorPZ69F_dT65HRiFOxQOucTUeRjUOhEueynF3s7c6b9PpYwebaQpJxh1UfmC8OI6tP0_iC2zzm9N8RjphESYQdzIvinDTHhsxRbNZSwmPNI2Djz_xg==) . Sezzle Up adds credit history building to that toolkit. Eligible users can choose to have their Sezzle payment history reported to the four major credit bureaus, so the payments they already make can help build a credit history, with no credit card, fee, or extra spending required.


To measure the impact, Sezzle analyzed roughly 83,000 Sezzle Up users with no late payments from December 2024 to April 2026, using TransUnion VantageScore 3.0 scores it periodically pulls across its broader user base. The study compared them with Sezzle shoppers who also paid on time but weren't being reported yet.


**Key findings among users with no late payments:**


-


**A first score for people new to credit.**


86% of studied Sezzle Up users whose TransUnion file had too little history to generate a score had a VantageScore 3.0 within two to four months, compared with 29% of comparable shoppers. The median first score was 657, and 91% landed at 600 or above.


-


**The biggest lift for thin credit files.**


Over four months, users with only one or two accounts on their credit file gained about 19 more points than comparable shoppers.


-


**More users moving up a tier.**


15% of users starting in subprime (300 to 600) moved up to near prime or better within four months, compared with 11% of comparable shoppers.


-


**Gains that last.**


Users starting below 600 were up 27.9 points after 12 months, compared with 22.3 points for similar shoppers who never joined Sezzle Up, keeping them 5.5 points ahead.


-


**Faster gains for lower starting scores.**


Users starting below 600, who made up 73% of newly reported users, gained 17.6 points in four months, 8.7 more than comparable shoppers.


*“For decades, building credit meant opening a credit card. We think it should work however our shoppers choose to pay,”* **said**[Charlie Youakim](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nW3ZyYVTC_ei3tZ-uMdU5bMnW8yZH6cs6BZkfwwlLvRLPIAGW1tAg3mw068FKNuBCr9WGekJxIOYcdpikUenkZiJrsTqnHxrc7As-y13TNDOmQKoRrYflPSUUhKvow9W) **, CEO and Executive Chairman of Sezzle.** *“Sezzle Up does that for free, turning everyday on-time payments into a credit profile, and our users’ scores are showing it. Today’s shoppers deserve a better on-ramp to credit, and we’re building it.”*


**Sezzle Up is free and completely opt-in.** Once enrolled, users have one account reported to the credit bureaus each month, covering their eligible Sezzle orders. Sezzle reports both on-time payments and payments 30 or more days past due, and only reports activity after a user enrolls. Shoppers who don’t enroll are not reported.


One Sezzle user summed it up in an App Store review in September: *“I use Sezzle all the time and have had a great experience with it. I also use the Sezzle Up program, which is a great feature for helping build credit while using the service.”*


Eligible users can join Sezzle Up in the Sezzle app.[Download the app here.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pJUYI928-KRTqjRUSKfr7zCGqHirJxaR24VJDKDg8haDHf4Dzks4sOg5wiu3kyYPBXc_Ye8N7izrpRtE9UuoNQeobsbtS8UdnmQHdX2rkb0=)


***** Opt-in to voluntary credit reporting by enrolling in Sezzle Up.


Increases or specific changes to your credit score are not guaranteed. Impact on your credit score may vary depending on your use. All payments, including late payments, are required to be reported, which may negatively impact your credit score. Credit scores are independently determined by credit bureaus based on a number of factors, including the financial decisions you make with other financial services organizations. The program and related services will not remove negative credit history from your credit report.


**Methodology:**


*Sezzle’s internal analysis looked at TransUnion VantageScore 3.0 scores for 82,841 Sezzle Up users with no late payments, measured every four months from December 2024 to April 2026. Users were compared with similar Sezzle shoppers whose payments were not yet being reported or who never joined Sezzle Up. “No late payments” means no Sezzle payment was reported 30 or more days past due and the account was current at each score pull. The new-to-credit finding is based on 748 users whose file had too little history to generate a score when reporting began.*


*Results are based on TransUnion VantageScore 3.0 and apply to that model only. Late payments are also reported and can lower credit scores. Individual results vary. VantageScore® is a registered trademark of VantageScore Solutions, LLC. TransUnion® is a registered trademark of TransUnion LLC.*
